proof:
have hx : x ≠ 0 := by
  intro hx
  have : (3 : ℝ) + 1 / x = 0 := by simpa [hx] using h₁
  linarith
have hmul : x * (3 + 1 / x) = x * (7 / x) := by
  simpa [h₁]
have : 3 * x + 1 = 7 := by
  simpa [mul_add, mul_assoc, hx, mul_div_cancel'] using hmul
linarith
